entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I need to process a return for a helmet I purchased a little while back.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-03-B1. I should also mention the box is unopened, it's just been sitting here.
Thank you for that. I'm pulling up the order now. Before we go further, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's a preference thing. The color just wasn't what I expected when it arrived, and I never got around to sending it back. I want to make sure I get a replacement I'm happy with for safety reasons, you know?
I understand completely. Getting the right gear is crucial for safety. Let me just check the delivery date here... Okay, I see it was delivered 84 days ago. One moment while I review our policy.
Alright, I've confirmed it. Because this is a standard item, our policy allows for returns within 90 days. You are well within that window, so I can approve this return for a full refund.
That's excellent news, thank you, Charlie.
You're very welcome. I'm emailing you the return shipping label now. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it at any post office.

Okay, sounds easy enough. Just one more question. Since I'll be buying another helmet from you and this was a simple color issue, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase to offset the time and effort?

I appreciate you asking, and I'm glad you're choosing VeloFit for your next purchase. However, my system doesn't allow me to issue credits or discounts for preference-based returns. The good news is the full refund for the helmet is already approved and on its way once we receive the item.
I see. I thought it was worth a shot. No problem, I'll go ahead and use the label you're sending. Thank you for your help today.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day!
